Maximize the sale and distribution of all company products in the assigned region through the establishment and appropriate execution of local and national sales programs. title: Pessoa Captadora de Recursos - Rio de Janeiro
description: Descrição e Responsabilidades MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações. Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos. CONTEXTO DA VAGA A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras. Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana, abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo. É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa. Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você! COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo), apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF. Preservar a imagem de MSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação. Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema. Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores. REQUISITOS Português fluente. Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação. Pacote Office básico. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS Gerenciamento de estresse, pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma. Capacidade de negociação, para comunicar aos outros seus próprios objetivos e demandas. Iniciativa e inovação, para identificar oportunidades e problemas. Flexibilidade comportamental, para adaptar comportamentos às necessidades da situação. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Clerkship Coordinator - Neurology
description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Basic Function The Clerkship Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administrative and operational management of the medical student clerkship within the Department of Neurology. This position serves as a key member of the undergraduate medical education team and supports the Clerkship Director in ensuring an organized, compliant, student-centered educational experience. The Clerkship Coordinator manages scheduling, evaluations, educational activities, accreditation‑related documentation, student communications, and clerkship operations across clinical training sites. The position requires a high degree of independence, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced academic clinical environment. Supervisory Accountability Reports directly to the Clerkship Director. May provide operational guidance to student workers and administrative support staff involved in clerkship activities. Nature And Scope The Clerkship Coordinator works closely with faculty, residents, medical students, Faculty Practice, Hospital and affiliate site personnel, curriculum administrators, and institutional leadership to support the successful operation of the clerkship program. Internal Contacts Include Clerkship Directors Faculty and residents Medical students Department administrators Curriculum and Dean’s Office personnel Information technology and educational support staff External Contacts May Include Affiliate hospitals and clinical training sites Accreditation representatives and surveyors Vendors and educational software support personnel Principal Accountabilities Clerkship Operations and Administration Coordinate and manage all administrative aspects of the clerkship program. Develop, maintain, adjust and distribute student rotation schedules, call schedules, orientation materials, and clerkship calendars. Coordinate student assignments to clinical teams, faculty, and affiliate sites. Ensure students receive timely onboarding information, institutional requirements, and site‑specific documentation. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Student Assessment and Evaluation Management Manage evaluation processes within educational management systems (e.g., E*Value or equivalent platforms). Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and escalate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid‑clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Accreditation and Compliance Support Assist the Clerkship Director with maintaining compliance with LCME accreditation standards and institutional educational policies. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Communication and Student Support Serve as a primary administrative contact for medical students during the clerkship. Communicate policies, schedules, deadlines, and expectations to students and faculty. Address routine student concerns and elevate issues appropriately to clerkship leadership. Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive student and faculty matters. Administrative and Financial Support Assist with departmental administrative processes related to the clerkship program. Prepare reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, and presentations. Support tracking of program‑related expenditures and administrative documentation as assigned. Coordinate meetings and maintain meeting materials and records. Student Recommendation Letters & Residency Application Support Coordinate collection of materials for Department Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, scholarship letters, and specialty‑specific evaluations. Maintain tracking system for all requested letters. ERAS / Residency Application Support. Upload and manage letters through Electronic Residency Application Service ERAS. Ensure timely submission of Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, Letters of Recommendation, Department forms, coordinated standardized letters such as SLOE (Standardized Letter of Evaluation) when required, and confirm deadlines and specialty‑specific requirements. Confidentiality & Professionalism Maintain FERPA‑compliant handling of student records and confidential recommendation materials. Additional Responsibilities Participate in departmental, institutional, and clerkship coordinator meetings and professional development activities. Perform other related duties as assigned in support of undergraduate medical education programs. Core Competencies Knowledge of undergraduate medical education operations and accreditation standards preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). Ability to analyze data and prepare reports. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast‑paced, highly regulated educational environment. Minimum Requirements High school diploma or GED required. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative, program coordination, healthcare, higher education, or medical education experience required. Associate degree and 3 years of relevant experience. Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of relevant experience. Experience in academic medicine, healthcare, higher education, or medical education preferred. Strong organizational, communication, and technology skills required. Experience with educational management systems and scheduling software preferred. Salary Range $55,000 - $60,000 Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure #J-18808-Ljbffr

Este é um ambiente para engenheiros de ML que valorizam práticas de engenharia rigorosas, impacto mensurável e colaboração com especialistas em ciência de materiais, digital e ciência de dados. Qualificações necessárias: Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Econometria ou área relacionada, com sólida experiência prática no desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, aprendizado profundo e IA em produção. Bons conhecimentos de SQL para recuperar e manipular dados de forma eficaz. Sólidos conhecimentos das melhores práticas de engenharia de software e ferramentas de conteinerização (Docker). Sólida compreensão de estatística, algoritmos e estruturas de dados. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos tanto para partes interessadas técnicas quanto não técnicas. Habilidades preferenciais: Familiaridade com plataformas em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e MLOps. Bons conhecimentos e experiência em visão computacional, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP) e/ou modelos de IA (LLMs e multimodais). Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e mentalidade orientada para os detalhes. Capacidade de gerenciar vários projetos simultaneamente. title: Senior Process Optimization (RTO/ROMeo) & Digital Twin (PST) Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabi[...]
description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted. *** Candidates with Chemical Engineering degree and 17-25 years of experience in Refinery Only*** ***English proficiency (written and spoken) required. Submit CV in English for consideration*** Overview We are seeking an experienced Process Simulation Twin (PST) and Optimization Engineer to join our Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) within our Global Manufacturing Excellence Center. Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. Your primary role is to deploy and sustain online process simulations (process digital twins), perform process optimization activities to identify opportunities, monitor process performance KPIs and develop advanced process optimization data-enabled solutions. This role sits at the boundary of process engineering and digitalization beyond traditional process simulation roles. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between rigorous thermodynamic models, process digital twins, real-time process data and hybrid analytics through AI. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of PST that integrate real-time process data with rigorous equation-oriented or sequential simulation engines in alignment with corporate objectives. Configure and troubleshoot the connectivity between plant historians, laboratory information systems, and simulation software to ensure seamless data ingestion and reconciliation. Utilize PST to perform automated monitoring of facility health, detecting deviations between ideal performance and actual plant operations to identify opportunity gaps. Develop and maintain thermodynamic models and mathematical equations that accurately represent the behavior of various processes ensuring the PST accurately reflects the current state of the facility (including heat exchanger fouling, catalyst decay, etc.). Perform offline engineering studies using PST to analyze complex operational problems, debottleneck constraints, and conduct "what-if" scenarios based on current operating conditions. Act as the technical liaison between data teams and Operations/Process Engineering teams, leading technical sessions on model architecture, data quality, and commissioning. Lead process optimization sessions to de-bottleneck key process units such as CDU/VDU, Hydrocrackers, Catalytic crackers, Diesel Hydrotreaters, Isomerization. Benchmark process optimization KPIs with 15+ operating facilities and provide development of programs, processes, guidelines and best practices. Provide subject matter expertise to operating facilities Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams by consulting, providing awareness sessions, and participating and leading technical exchanges and conferences. You must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience in Process Simulations, Online Modeling, or Real-Time Optimization (preferably ROMeo). 20 years of experience is preferred. You will be able to Demonstrate expertise in process engineering and flowsheet-based processes simulation. Preferred Equation Oriented simulation. You will have comprehensive understanding of refinery facilities, feedstock/product movements, margins, giveaways, process yields, and mass and energy balances. Demonstrated experience connecting simulations to live data sources (Data Historians, OPC, etc.). Strong understanding of data reconciliation, model tuning, and dealing with gross errors in industrial data is also required. Work Location and Work Schedule Work location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Product Operations
description: Sobre a Osklen Osklen é a expressão de um lifestyle definido pelo equilíbrio da vida urbana integrada à natureza, em que o orgânico e o tecnológico, o local e o global, o luxo e a simplicidade são conceitos complementares. Criada em 1989 por Oskar Metsavaht, artista, designer e ambientalista, a marca lidera a inovação em moda sustentável, se compromete com atitudes socioambientais positivas em parceria com o Instituto‑E*, em prol do desenvolvimento humano sustentável, e é referência por seu estilo autoral, inovação em design e uso de materiais desenvolvidos com critérios sociais, ambientais e econômicos, os e‑fabrics. As coleções reforçam a união de arte, design, lifestyle e sustentabilidade, priorizando a sustentabilidade através de materiais e processos de fabricação com menor impacto socioambiental. Promovemos diversidade e inclusão em nossos processos seletivos, incentivando a candidatura de profissionais sem discriminação de raça, etnia, religião, cor, sexo, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. Requisitos necessários Conhecimento sólido da plataforma VTEX (catálogo, pedidos, promoções e configurações da loja); Experiência com operações de e‑commerce e projetos digitais; Vivência na interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia; Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e acompanhamento de implementações sistêmicas; Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban); Experiência com Jira e Notion; Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e análises de dados. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and elevate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid‑clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam‑security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). This position serves as a key member of the undergraduate medical education team and supports the Clerkship Director in ensuring an organized, compliant, student‑centered educational experience. The Clerkship Coordinator manages scheduling, evaluations, educational activities, accreditation‑related documentation, student communications, and clerkship operations across clinical training sites. The position requires a high degree of independence, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced academic clinical environment. Supervisory Accountability Reports directly to the Clerkship Director. May provide operational guidance to student workers and administrative support staff involved in clerkship activities. Nature and Scope The Clerkship Coordinator works closely with faculty, residents, medical students, Faculty Practice, Hospital and affiliate site personnel, curriculum administrators, and institutional leadership to support the successful operation of the clerkship program. Internal Contacts Include Clerkship Directors Faculty and residents Medical students Department administrators Curriculum and Dean’s Office personnel Information technology and educational support staff External Contacts May Include Affiliate hospitals and clinical training sites Accreditation representatives and surveyors Vendors and educational software support personnel Principal Accountabilities Clerkship Operations and Administration Coordinate and manage all administrative aspects of the clerkship program. Develop, maintain, adjust and distribute student rotation schedules, call schedules, orientation materials, and clerkship calendars. Coordinate student assignments to clinical teams, faculty, and affiliate sites. Ensure students receive timely onboarding information, institutional requirements, and site‑specific documentation. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Student Assessment and Evaluation Management Manage evaluation processes within educational management systems (e.g., E*Value or equivalent platforms). Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and elevate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid‑clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Accreditation and Compliance Support Assist the Clerkship Director with maintaining compliance with LCME accreditation standards and institutional educational policies. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Communication and Student Support Serve as a primary administrative contact for medical students during the clerkship. Communicate policies, schedules, deadlines, and expectations to students and faculty. Address routine student concerns and elevate issues appropriately to clerkship leadership. Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive student and faculty matters. Administrative and Financial Support Assist with departmental administrative processes related to the clerkship program. Prepare reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, and presentations. Support tracking of program‑related expenditures and administrative documentation as assigned. Coordinate meetings and maintain meeting materials and records. Student Recommendation Letters & Residency Application Support Coordinate collection of materials for Department Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, scholarship letters, and specialty‑specific evaluations. Maintain tracking system for all requested letters. ERAS / Residency Application Support. Upload and manage letters through Electronic Residency Application Service ERAS. Ensure timely submission of: Chair letters Clerkship Director letters Letters of Recommendation Department forms Coordinate standardized letters such as SLOE (Standardized Letter of Evaluation) when required. Confirm deadlines and specialty‑specific requirements. Confidentiality / Professionalism Maintain FERPA‑compliant handling of student records and confidential recommendation materials. Additional Responsibilities Participate in departmental, institutional, and clerkship coordinator meetings and professional development activities. Perform other related duties as assigned in support of undergraduate medical education programs. Core Competencies Knowledge of undergraduate medical education operations and accreditation standards preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). Ability to analyze data and prepare reports. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast‑paced, highly regulated educational environment. Minimum Requirements High school diploma or GED required. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative, program coordination, healthcare, higher education, or medical education experience required. Associate degree and 3 years of relevant experience. Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of relevant experience. Experience in academic medicine, healthcare, higher education, or medical education preferred. Strong organizational, communication, and technology skills required. Experience with educational management systems and scheduling software preferred. Salary Range $55,000 - $60,000 Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. title: Admissions and Student Engagement Specialist
description: Benefits Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture For more benefits details, visit Job Purpose The Admissions & Student Engagement Specialist supports the full continuum of student engagement at the College of Dentistry—from initial applicant inquiry through enrollment and ultimately graduation. This position plays a critical role in the administrative, operational, and customer‐service functions of both admissions and student programs. The Specialist ensures efficient processing of applicant materials, contributes to the evaluation and interview process, and supports initiatives that enhance student engagement, orientation, retention, and milestone events. The individual in this role represents the College professionally to prospective students, applicants, families, external partners, and internal University stakeholders, demonstrating the College’s commitment to academic excellence, professionalism, and service. Supervisory Authority This position does not directly supervise staff but provides functional oversight and guidance to student assistants, ambassadors, and volunteers supporting admissions, orientation, and commencement activities. Principal Accountabilities Admissions Operations and Applicant Management Coordinates the interview process for applicants, including file review preparation, interview scheduling, session facilitation, and processing of application fees. Oversees the processing, tracking, and maintenance of applicant files, ensuring timely data entry and accuracy of records. Evaluates applications and supporting documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and flags irregularities or potential misconduct. Advises prospective students and applicants on admissions policies, requirements, and timelines. Prepares admissions‑related reports for the Dean, the Director, College leadership, and external associations as required. Maintains compliance with institutional, accreditation, and ADEA guidelines related to admissions documentation, confidentiality, and applicant data. Manages the full onboarding and enrollment process for incoming predoctoral students, including verification of admissions requirements, collection and tracking of matriculation documents, immunization and compliance records, and University credentialing to ensure all students are fully cleared for enrollment. Student Engagement and Success Initiatives Supports programs and activities that foster a welcoming and supportive environment for incoming students. Assists with the planning and implementation of New Student Orientation in collaboration with the Director of Admissions and Student Ambassadors. Executes pre‑matriculation communication plans to ensure incoming students remain informed, prepared, and connected prior to enrollment. Supports student milestone events—including Opening Ceremony, White Coat Ceremony, Match Day, and Commencement—ensuring a positive and professional student experience throughout the lifecycle. Recruitment, Outreach, and Representation Represents the College at recruitment fairs, pipeline programs, high school and college visits, and national or regional pre‑dental events in absence of or at the request of the Director. Assists with preparation of recruitment materials, presentations, and digital content highlighting student success, College programs, and mission‑focused initiatives. Participates in staff meetings, retreats, and strategic planning activities related to recruiting, retention, and student engagement. University and Institutional Coordination Serves as the College’s liaison to the University Commencement Committee; attends meetings, provides updates, and ensures timely submission and proofing of Commencement Program content. Prepares graduation recommendations for the Office of the Provost and oversees diploma ordering and fulfillment. Coordinates institutional data requests and end‑of‑year reporting for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Core Competencies Student‑Centered Service Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and responsiveness when engaging with applicants and students. Maintains a positive, solutions‑oriented approach to student support. Organizational Excellence Ability to manage complex workflows, multitask, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in data and documentation. Strong attention to detail and confidentiality. Professional Communication Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Ability to interact effectively with diverse audiences, including prospective and current students, families, faculty, staff, and external partners. Collaboration & Interpersonal Skills Demonstrated ability to work across academic and administrative units to achieve shared goals. Comfortable guiding student assistants, ambassadors, and volunteers. Integrity, Compliance, and Judgment Adheres to FERPA, accreditation standards, and institutional policies governing sensitive information. Exercises sound judgment, discretion, and ethical decision‑making. Technical Skills Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ability to learn CRM systems, admissions software, Banner, WebAdMIT, Slate, Workday, or other student information platforms. Comfortable with data entry, digital communication tools, and document management. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree required, preference for program in Education, Higher Education, Counseling, Business, Communications, or a related field. Experience: 1–2 years of experience in admissions, student services, customer service, recruitment, or administrative support. Experience in higher education or health‑professions settings preferred. Experience with event coordination (orientation, ceremonies, recruitment) strongly preferred. Salary Range Expected Pay Range: $72,539 - $79,793 #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Rio de Janeiro
description: A Eneva no Rio de Janeiro quer você no time! #VemSerEneva Se você quer atuar como Advogado(a) Pleno foco em Governança Corporativa, Privacidade e Proteção de Dados, temos um novo desafio para você! Sobre a Eneva A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural do Brasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançando de maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em um contexto de crescimento e amadurecimento institucional, a companhia fortalece continuamente suas estruturas de governança, integridade, gestão de riscos e conformidade regulatória, com foco em transparência, sustentabilidade e criação de valor de longo prazo. Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) advogado(a) pleno(a) para atuar com autonomia e proficiência nas iniciativas de Governança Corporativa, Privacidade e Proteção de Dados da companhia. A posição será referência técnica para áreas de negócio e órgãos de governança, assegurando conformidade legal, alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado e evolução contínua das políticas e processos corporativos. Terá atuação integrada com as áreas de Riscos, Segurança da Informação, Auditoria, TI e demais áreas de negócio, com foco especial na execução e amadurecimento do programa de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados (LGPD). Principais responsabilidades Governança Corporativa Atuar no suporte a temas de governança corporativa, realizando pesquisas, análises e elaboração de pareceres preliminares, com escalonamento adequado de temas de maior complexidade; Apoiar a uniformização de entendimentos e a aplicação de políticas, diretrizes e padrões de governança, garantindo alinhamento às melhores práticas e à conformidade normativa; Apoiar o funcionamento dos órgãos de governança, elaborando minutas de pautas e atas, além de análises iniciais de aderência das deliberações aos normativos internos; Atuar como ponto focal para coleta e consolidação de informações junto às áreas internas para pautas, relatórios e demandas regulatórias; Atuar na atualização de políticas e diretrizes corporativas, incluindo pesquisas e benchmarkings sobre práticas de governança; Apoiar a identificação de riscos de governança, recomendação de controles mitigadores e acompanhamento de planos de ação em conjunto com áreas de negócio e auditorias; Participar da elaboração e condução de treinamentos e comunicações internas, promovendo a cultura de transparência, integridade e responsabilidade corporativa; Elaborar relatórios, apresentações e indicadores de governança; Apoiar a preparação, atualização e organização de documentos e informações periódicas e eventuais de Companhia Aberta, em conformidade com as exigências da CVM. Privacidade e Proteção de Dados Apoiar a execução do programa de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados, incluindo manutenção do ROPA, definição de bases legais, controles por ciclo de vida do dado e mapeamentos de tratamento; Atuar com autonomia na análise de demandas das áreas de negócio, assegurando aderência à LGPD e às políticas internas; Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão de documentos técnicos, como RIPD/DPIA, LIA, avaliações de transferência internacional, classificação e retenção de dados, alinhados às boas práticas (ISO/IEC 27701/27001, NIST Privacy); Prestar suporte consultivo em temas de privacidade, com preparação de pareceres preliminares e alinhamento de entendimentos internos; Apoiar a revisão e negociação de cláusulas contratuais relacionadas à proteção de dados (controlador–operador, co-controladoria e transferência internacional); Atuar no suporte à gestão de incidentes de dados pessoais, em conjunto com Segurança da Informação, Jurídico e Comunicação; Contribuir para iniciativas de privacy by design, avaliando novos produtos, serviços e mudanças de processos; Apoiar avaliações de risco de privacidade em fornecedores, parceiros e projetos; Participar da elaboração e execução de treinamentos, materiais educativos e comunicações internas sobre privacidade; Monitorar atualizações da ANPD, jurisprudência e tendências regulatórias, analisando impactos e propondo ajustes internos; Consolidar indicadores, evidências e informações para relatórios e dashboards do programa de privacidade; Apoiar a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e automação dos processos de privacidade. Requisitos e qualificações Formação Graduação completa em Direito, com OAB Ativa; Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Governança Corporativa, Compliance, Proteção de Dados, Direito Digital ou áreas correlatas. Experiência e conhecimentos Experiência prévia em Governança Corporativa e/ou Privacidade e Proteção de Dados; Conhecimento da LGPD, boas práticas de governança e estruturas de compliance; Vivência em elaboração e revisão de políticas corporativas e documentos regulatórios; Experiência em interação com áreas multidisciplinares e órgãos de governança; Diferencial: atuação em companhias abertas ou ambientes altamente regulados. Competências comportamentais Visão sistêmica e senso crítico; Capacidade analítica e organização; Comunicação clara e habilidade de relacionamento; Autonomia com responsabilidade e foco em conformidade; Perfil colaborativo e orientado a melhoria contínua. Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ. Saiba mais sobre nós em: A Eneva é uma empresa séria e comprometida com a transparência em seus processos seletivos e não solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento durante o processo de seleção. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas também a candidatos PcDs. #J-18808-Ljbffr

What you'll bring 3+ years of experience in accounting, with exposure to various areas such as AP, revenue recognition, and financial reporting. Experience with enterprise-level accounting ERP systems (Sage preferred; NetSuite or Oracle also acceptable). Knowledge of US accounting standards, with international English experience and the ability to work within a global team. Strong understanding of the monthly close process and ability to manage diverse accounting functions. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken. title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de JaneiroRJ
description: CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Município do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e à integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem‑estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público‑alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer as ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. In your daily routine, you will be led 100% in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Captain
description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Join Howard University and thrive with us! Basic Function The purpose of this position is to assist in the management of the Department of Public Safety (DPS) by providing administrative oversight and assisting in policy development. It may be designated Shift Commander and provide supervision and coordination over the daily operations of assigned personnel in keeping with established goals and objectives of the Department of Public Safety serving the Howard University and Howard University Hospital (HUH). SUPERVISORY Acts in a senior management capacity over other positions; orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. Accountability Internal contacts include academic and medical executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the University and Hospital. External contacts include parent/guardians, patients, Mayoral Command Post, representatives from local and national Homeland security operations, social service agencies, special police officers, Security Officer’s Management Branch, members of the local criminal justice system to include Metropolitan Police, U.S. Attorney’s Office, Department of Corrections, Youth Services organizations, etc. and the general public. Principal Accountabilities Serves as a Commander over a large section or Division of the Howard University/HUH Department of Public Safety Operation; responsible for all operations in assigned sector on a 24 hour per day basis; administers comprehensive security programs to prevent crimes against persons and property on University Campus and HUH. Provides supervision and oversight over the duties of Deputy Shift Commander in shift operations to ensure that duties involving training and overseeing patrol activities, e.g. directing traffic, controlling crowds; securing facilities are conducted successfully. Works with higher management to develop procedures and directives, rules and regulations for the effective operations of the Department of Public Safety Police force within the guidelines of University, HUH, Federal and Municipal Governments’ laws and statutes. Prepares high level administrative reports, provides statistical data, reviews all incident reports; advises HUH and University management on security issues. Makes comprehensive plans to coordinate special events with the DC Office of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security or other federal or municipal agency; takes appropriate actions in response to unforeseen or unexpected incidents; ensures compliance with applicable policy, laws, rules and regulations; maintains emergency plans and makes determination as to when plans should be employed. May manage and coordinate plans and set priorities for fiscal activities of entire Department of Public Safety or may supervise and assist in the preparation of the annual budget for assigned sector; submits recommendations to management for review; may participate in the selection and evaluation process of new employees. Assists in establishing performance metrics consistent with the duties and responsibilities for the Department of Public Safety and HUH. Periodically inspects departments, facilities, equipment and personnel to ensure their safety and compliance with Department of Public Safety policies and procedures. Makes long term projection for labor distribution to ensure that critical areas are covered; provides instruction to immediate subordinates in the proper performance of their duties. May coordinate the acquisition and maintenance of Police equipment; direct the issuance of equipment and ensures accountability for equipment materials and supplies including automobiles, communication equipment, uniforms etc. May confer with management, to review achievements and discuss changes in long and short range goals and objectives; may monitor and plan the training schedule for in-house and outside agencies; maintain expiration roster and prepares license renewal for officers. Responds in person to the most serious incidents when called by subordinates to incidents occurring on University or HUH property; establishes a Field Command Post to supervise and direct police activities; meets with outside law enforcement and regulatory agencies. Assists the Chief and Deputy Chief with various policy, fiscal, budgetary, human resources and other administrative matters as required. May serve in the absence of the Deputy Chief as required. Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Chief of the Department of Public Safety or other relevant authority. Core Competencies Extensive knowledge of criminal law, including elements of offenses, rules of evidence, laws of arrest, search and seizures, methods of law enforcement, maintenance of public safety and security, and related law enforcement principles. Extensive knowledge of current departmental, municipal and governmental policies and procedural changes relating to security. Ability to demonstrate expertise in hospital safety and security principles and practices in order to effectively assist in the directing of the Hospital’s safety and security programs and activities. Ability to maintain and provide a general source of University, Hospital and community information. General knowledge of computer programs, to include word processing, spreadsheet, database and presentation software. Enhanced skills in the use of firearms and other standard police equipment with the ability to secure a Special Police Officer Commission with firearm authorization from the District of Columbia. Enhanced skills in the use of both oral and written English with the ability to read technical literature, write investigative reports and to express complex cases and relationships orally and written forms. Excellent skill in public and customer relations with the ability to use tact, diplomacy and decorum. Ability to make public presentations, to negotiate and to successfully navigate internal and external politics. Ability to direct others in the investigative process and to provide leadership, training and direction to subordinates. Ability to remain emotionally stable and to display mature judgment and tact in explosive and/or dangerous situations. Ability to work a flexible schedule and be on call during a 24 hour a day, seven days per week timeframe. Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with staff, students, university officials, faculty, other public safety organizations; and the general public. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Law Enforcement, Criminal Justice or closely related field and four (4) years of work experience which included three (3) years at a supervisory level or the equivalent combination of eight (8) years combined relevant training and experience. Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Expected Pay Range: $80,000 to $85,000 #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Change Manager, LATAM OU
description: Change Manager – Role Overview The Change Manager is crucial in shaping how people experience and contribute to change across Haleon. The role enables, coordinates and executes our strategic programmes, owning the local change strategy and roadmap within an assigned Operating Unit to ensure a coherent change experience. The role focuses on the people side of change – identifying, preparing, and equipping our colleagues to adopt changes in ways of working, roles, operating models, business processes, systems, technology, culture and more. It reports into the Change Management CoE Director and supports a collaborative effort to drive change excellence at scale. Key Responsibilities Drive the execution of strategic transformation initiatives landing in assigned Operating Unit by developing a change strategy and actionable roadmap. Conduct change diagnostics (e.g., impact assessments) to identify targeted change interventions and ensure alignment to Haleon’s culture strategy during planning and execution. Support the delivery and adoption of change through facilitating workshops, defining success metrics, assessing change effectiveness, measuring adoption, and coordinating local knowledge management plans. Partner with Programmes to develop local business readiness criteria ahead of going‑live with change initiatives. Hold programme and business leads accountable for leader‑led change execution. Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential resistance, proactively identifying targeted mitigations. Coordinate change activities across stakeholders and teams (HR, Communications, Programmes, Capability Leads, L&D, etc.) and act as a bridge between programmes and local teams. Develop and oversee the implementation of local communications and engagement plans, including mapping key stakeholders, agreeing the engagement approach with business leaders and HR, and tailoring programme change narratives for local needs. Build a holistic change capability strategy and plan for assigned Operating Unit, ensuring alignment to the enterprise skills framework. Develop and execute the change learning plan and curriculum with subject matter experts, partner with Programme leads, Capability Leads, and HR to identify training needs and ensure appropriate training plans are in place, including measuring effectiveness. Coach and upskill business leaders on change management, holding them to account for role‑modeling change and culture and driving uptake in their Operating Unit. Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing through the change management community of practice. Review and report on change outcomes and benefits, grounded in metrics, with clear ROI and linked to business outcomes. Identify, document and support the mitigation of key change management risks within the assigned Operating Unit and work across workstreams to implement interventions and resolve issues. Basic Qualifications Proven track record of executing change programs within complex, matrixed environments, demonstrating effectiveness across diverse global teams. Proficiency with portfolio‑level change management, including prioritisation, sequencing and operating across interdependent transformations. Ability to translate an enterprise‑level change strategy and roadmap into an executable and measurable local adoption plan. Strong understanding of change management best practices, tools and techniques, and practical implementation. Strong communication and relationship‑building skills, simplifying complex messages for business leaders. Strong problem‑solving and planning skills, working through ambiguity and adapting delivery approaches. Ability to influence and navigate across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders, including Leaders, Line Managers, HRBPs, L&D, etc. Preferred Qualifications PROSCI and/or APMG Change Practitioner certification (preferred). Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations and operating model components. Demonstrated ability to coach sponsors, cultivate change champions and drive business accountability for change. Solid understanding of how people experience change and drivers of change, embedding mindset and culture shifts across teams. Strong data fluency, leveraging analytics and insights to drive adoption; proficiency with change management, collaboration and digital adoption tools. description: Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. À medida que a alta liderança identifica oportunidades relevantes no negócio, esta posição é alocada para entrar no problema, conduzir a análise de ponta a ponta e sair com recomendações concretas e acionáveis — atuando também na implementação quando o projeto pedir. Capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos e conduzi-los até uma recomendação concreta com pouca supervisão. Fluência ou disposição genuína em usar ferramentas de IA como parte central do trabalho analítico. Autonomia, senso de dono e maturidade para navegar diferentes áreas do grupo. Diferenciais (nice to have) Experiência em concepção ou desenvolvimento de produtos/projetos digitais. Vivência em ambientes de varejo, moda, e-commerce ou bens de consumo. Entregar complete staff work: chegar até o final do raciocínio e apresentar recomendações prontas para decisão, com trade-offs explícitos e premissas declaradas — não análises em aberto que devolvem o problema para quem pediu. Usar ferramentas de IA como alavanca central de análise — acelerando pesquisa, processamento de dados, prototipagem de soluções e geração de insumos para decisão. Traduzir análise em comunicação executiva: documentos e apresentações diretos, bem estruturados e proporcionais à decisão em jogo, voltados a CEO e diretoria. Participar da implementação das recomendações quando aplicável — acompanhando execução, ajustando o curso com base em resultados e garantindo que a análise vire impacto real. Trabalhar lado a lado com as áreas donas de cada problema, navegando contextos distintos do grupo (marcas, varejo, operações, digital) sem gerar atrito de "área que audita área".
