title: Integrity Engineer
description: Job Function: Employment Type: Permanent Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Sumary: Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Specialist Engineer - Process Control
description: Employment type: Employee Place of work: Hybrid Offshore/Onshore: Onshore TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. Job Purpose We are looking for a Senior Process Control Engineer! We are seeking a motivated Senior Engineer to join our global team specializing in Process Control for subsea oil and gas process systems. Process Control is a core competency in the Power & Processing (P&P) department. They are responsible for developing and designing the automation system controlling the subsea processing equipment, including control algorithms and operating procedures to ensure safe and efficient operation. The Senior Process Control Engineer works as part of the system engineering team to ensure that the subsea processing equipment operates within its design limitations and that the system operation is robust and efficient. The work requires a thorough understanding of multiphase processing with expertise in process control and the design and implementation of closed loop control. To achieve this, the process control engineer collaborates closely with process, rotating equipment, high voltage power, flow assurance, instrumentation and control system disciplines within TechnipFMC. Job Description Provide a high level of expertise on technical solutions and engineering innovations as the Process Control Lead Engineer in studies, FEEDs, tenders, projects and aftermarket service engineering. Define the process control strategy, identify and analyse risks associated with operation and control of the system. Write functional specifications and test procedures for implementation and testing. Develop and review safety requirements for the system at HAZOP and LOPA meetings with Clients. Facilitate and lead internal and external meetings, reviews and project face‑to‑face meetings towards the client and sub suppliers as required. Follow up Dynamic process simulation studies to verify system and process control functions. Efficiently contribute to the project delivery phase through presentations, meetings and interfaces towards other key internal project packages. Lead or support function testing of the subsea process control implemented in delivery or R&D projects. Participate and support as TechnipFMC representative during offshore commissioning and start‑up. Provide operational support and consultation for problem solving and performance improvement as part of Life‑of‑Field service for Subsea Processing projects. Support the knowledge development within the discipline. Travel, both locally and internationally, should be expected. You are meant for this job if: You have a BSc, MSc or PhD within Cybernetics, Chemical Engineering or a similar education with a strong focus on Process Control engineering. At least 10 years relevant experience. Experience can compensate for lack of formal education. Experience with subsea process systems and products such as pumps and separators. Experience designing and implementing process control in oil and gas systems. Experience in interfacing other sub‑systems; especially Controls/Instruments, Flow Assurance, Process Engineering and Field Development. Experience with development and testing of process system components and full system solutions. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Willingness to learn, a growth mindset, and can adapt to a dynamic work environment. Fluent in English, (C1 or higher according to CEFR). Your Future at TechnipFMC Your journey starts with our onboarding program. As an international company, we provide you with great opportunities for internal growth. You will have the opportunity to attend development activities. We have benefits like company cabins, in‑house gym, and sports teams. You will be secured by good insurance and retirements plans. Collaborative and innovative atmosphere that promotes teamwork. Practicalities Deadline to apply: 29th of June 2026, we view CV's continously. Legal Information Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes equal opportunities and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture. TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Com uma estratégia de crescimento baseada em excelência operacional, disciplina financeira e desenvolvimento sustentável de ativos, a empresa oferece um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e orientado à geração de valor. Nesta posição, você atuará na interface entre Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Reservatórios e atividades de Subsuperfície, contribuindo para a maximização do valor dos ativos por meio da otimização da performance de poços e reservatórios, aumento da recuperação de hidrocarbonetos e suporte à tomada de decisão técnica e operacional. Buscamos profissionais com sólida experiência técnica, visão integrada de ativos, forte capacidade analítica e interesse em atuar em um ambiente offshore desafiador, colaborativo e em constante evolução. Responsabilidades e atribuições Engenharia de Produção e Performance de Poços Monitorar e analisar o desempenho de poços produtores e injetores; Identificar oportunidades de otimização da produção e aumento da recuperação de hidrocarbonetos; Realizar análises de perdas de produção e recomendar ações corretivas; Apoiar campanhas de teste de poços, intervenções, estimulações e workovers; Desenvolver e atualizar modelos de produção e análises de sistemas de elevação artificial; Contribuir para avaliações de integridade e confiabilidade dos sistemas de produção. Engenharia de Reservatórios e Subsuperfície Participar de estudos de caracterização e gerenciamento de reservatórios; Analisar dados de pressão, produção e injeção; Apoiar atividades de previsão de produção e estimativas de reservas; Contribuir para planos de desenvolvimento de campo e estratégias de drenagem; Participar de estudos de simulação dinâmica e avaliação de desempenho de reservatórios; Integrar dados geológicos, geofísicos e de produção para suporte à tomada de decisão. Interface Operacional e Multidisciplinar Atuar em parceria com equipes de Operações Offshore, Perfuração, Completação e Facilities; Fornecer suporte técnico para campanhas operacionais e intervenções em poços; Participar de reuniões de performance dos ativos e revisões operacionais; Elaborar relatórios técnicos, apresentações e indicadores de produção; Garantir alinhamento entre planejamento de produção e capacidade operacional. Segurança, Conformidade e Melhoria Contínua Assegurar conformidade com requisitos de segurança, meio ambiente e regulamentações aplicáveis; Participar de avaliações de risco e processos de gestão de mudanças; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos e metodologias de engenharia; Apoiar o desenvolvimento e padronização de procedimentos técnicos. Requisitos e qualificações Graduação em Engenharia de Petróleo ou áreas correlatas; Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Reservatórios ou atividades de Subsuperfície na indústria de óleo e gás; Experiência em análise de dados de produção e avaliação do comportamento de reservatórios; Conhecimento em sistemas de elevação artificial; Experiência com modelagem de produção e simulação de reservatórios; Conhecimento em análise nodal e performance de poços; Experiência em interpretação de testes de poços; Vivência com softwares de engenharia de reservatórios e produção; Inglês avançado ou fluente; Português fluente. Informações adicionais Experiência em ativos offshore; Vivência em ambientes operados; Experiência em estudos integrados de desenvolvimento de campo; Conhecimento em gestão integrada de ativos de produção; Familiaridade com projetos relacionados à maximização de recuperação de hidrocarbonetos; Experiência em equipes multidisciplinares envolvendo Geologia, Geofísica, Completação, Perfuração e Operações. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos.
